title: Concept: npm client configured with a cleartext registry
description: .npmrc declares an npm registry URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every package and every publish travels unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different tarball than the one the lockfile recorded.
risk: Every package and every publish travels unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different tarball than the one the lockfile recorded.
